name: Aurora Butterfly Garden in a Hollowed-out Glacier
description: Inside a translucent glacier cavity, butterflies with iridescent wings flutter, their colors mirroring the aurora borealis outside, light filters through ice, creating magical corridors.
prompt: Glacier interior with crystal-clear ice walls, butterflies with shimmering wings fluttering, their colors echoing the aurora dancing outside, shafts of light piercing the ice, quiet blue tones, fantasy, highly detailed, ethereal.
caption: Butterflies that mirror the northern lights 🦋✨ Glide into a glacier garden where ice and aurora unite.
